title: Don't Get Fooled! The Truth About The $5,000 Dividend Plan
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Weak jobs and soft PCE cut October hike odds from ~75% to ~23%; market is data-driven.
Expects CPI (Oct 13-14) likely to come in higher than expected because of oil, which could revive hike odds.
Bond yields still incredibly high and a concern he is watching.
Criticises $5,000 'dividend' pledge and Trump embracing inflation to pay off $41T debt.
